# 合规审核主控交接摘要模板

本文件定义合规审核向主控 Agent 交接的固定格式。

---

## 模板

```yaml
# === 合规审核主控交接摘要 ===
# 由 compliance-finalization-and-handoff skill 生成

metadata:
  handoff_id: ""               # CH-creative-001, CH-script-001 等
  series_id: ""
  episode_id: "ep01"
  target_stage: ""
  target_review_phase: ""      # pre_generation | post_generation
  target_file: ""
  target_version: ""
  generated_at: ""
  handoff_from: "compliance-review-agent"
  handoff_to: "producer-agent"

# === 合规结论 ===
conclusion_summary:
  verdict: ""                  # pass | conditional_pass | fail
  risk_level: ""               # high | medium | low
  gate_decision: ""            # allowed | conditional | blocked
  review_round: 1

# === 放行决策 ===
gate:
  can_proceed: true/false
  reason: ""

  # 如果可以推进
  if_proceed:
    next_stage: ""
    conditions: []
    required_actions: []

  # 如果不可推进
  if_blocked:
    blocked_reason: ""
    risk_types: []             # 具体风险类型列表
    fallback_stage: ""
    responsible_agent: ""
    fix_scope: ""
    fix_summary: []

  # 如果附条件推进
  if_conditional:
    conditions: []
    deadline: ""
    protections: []

# === 风险快照 ===
risk_snapshot:
  total: 0
  high: 0
  medium: 0
  low: 0
  top_risks: []               # 最严重的风险摘要

# === 重审要求 ===
retrial_info:
  required: true/false
  type: ""                     # full | partial | targeted
  scope: ""
  domains: []

# === 跨阶段影响 ===
cross_stage_impact:
  has_impact: true/false
  affected_stages: []
  affected_products: []
  needs_downstream_retrial: true/false
  details: []

# === 与业务审核的协调 ===
business_review_coordination:
  business_verdict: ""         # 如果业务审核已完成
  combined_decision: ""        # 综合决策
  conflict: true/false         # 是否存在冲突
  conflict_resolution: ""      # 冲突时的解决建议

# === 关联文件 ===
related_files:
  compliance_report: ""
  remediation_advice: ""
  previous_reports: []

# === 建议动作 ===
suggested_actions:
  - action: ""
    responsible: ""
    priority: ""               # P0 | P1 | P2
    description: ""
```

---

## 使用规则

1. 每次合规审核完成后必须生成交接摘要
2. 主控 Agent 应先读本交接摘要，再决定下一步动作
3. gate 部分是主控的核心决策依据
4. if_blocked 必须包含完整的回退路径和修复方向
5. cross_stage_impact 必须主动评估
6. business_review_coordination 必须说明与业务审核的协调方式
7. 合规 fail 具有一票否决权，主控不得在 can_proceed = false 时推进
8. 交接摘要存放路径：`project_data/projects/{project_id}/episodes/epXX/reviews/compliance/`

---

## 主控消费指南

主控 Agent 收到交接摘要后的处理逻辑：

| verdict | can_proceed | 主控动作 |
|---------|------------|---------|
| pass | true | 推进到下一阶段（需业务审核也通过） |
| conditional_pass | conditional | 指派责任 Agent 整改 → 整改后重审 |
| fail | false | 回退到指定阶段 → 指派责任 Agent 修复 → 修复后重审 |

### 合规与业务审核协调

| 合规结论 | 业务结论 | 综合决策 |
|---------|---------|---------|
| pass | pass | 推进 |
| pass | fail/rejected | 不推进（业务问题） |
| conditional_pass | pass | 附条件推进（先整改合规问题） |
| conditional_pass | fail/rejected | 不推进（双问题） |
| fail | pass | 不推进（合规一票否决） |
| fail | fail/rejected | 不推进（双问题） |
